de.abas.eks.jfop.annotation

Annotation Type RunFop


  • @Documented
 @Target(value=METHOD)
 @Retention(value=RUNTIME)
public @interface RunFop
    This annotation is used to mark the runFop method. If this annotation is used it is no longer necessary for a JFOP to implement the FOPRunnable or ContextRunnable interface.

    Example 1: 

     public class MyJFOP {
    @RunFop
    public void run() {
      FO.println("run");
    }
 }
    The annotated method can use one of several of the following parameters in its signature:
    • String[]: corresponds to the FOP arguments
    • DbContext: corresponds to the AJO context
    • FOPSessionContext: corresponds to the FO context

    The followng are valid for return values:

    • void
    • int/java.lang.Integer
    • CallResult
    Further examples: 
     public class MyJFOP {
    @RunFop
    public int test() {
      FO.println("run");
      return 0;
    }
 }
 
 public class MyJFOP {
    @RunFop
    public int test(String[] args) throws Exception {
      FO.println("run");
      return 0;
    }
 }
 
 @Stateful
 public class MyJFOP {
    @RunFop
    public CallResult test(DbContext ctx, String[] args) {
      FO.println("run");
      return CallResult.OK;
    }
 }
